definitions.explanation: A military encampment or the arrangement of troops on a field. Survives mainly in set phrases and historical writing, and in figures of speech drawn from them.

definitions.gloss: corps; lineup; body of people (as a suffix)
definitions.explanation: As a suffix on a noun, the assembled group of people in one role: {報道陣|ほうどうじん} (the press corps), {首脳陣|しゅのうじん} (the top brass). This is by far the commoner use in modern Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陣|じん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Breaking the enemy's formation is difficult.
He took up position with the river at his back because he had no intention of retreating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報道|ほうどう}{陣|じん}→報道陣：30542_houdoujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧{陣|じん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧。
examples.english: The pitching staff is deep this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首脳|しゅのう}{陣|じん}→首脳陣：30543_shunoujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{総入|そうい}れ{替|か}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The entire senior leadership was replaced, and the company's direction changed sharply.

notes:
Sense 2 is a suffix and never stands alone; learners meet it far more often than sense 1.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{報道|ほうどう}{陣|じん}→報道陣：30542_houdoujin⟧: the press corps
- ⟦{首脳|しゅのう}{陣|じん}→首脳陣：30543_shunoujin⟧: the top leadership
- ⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧{陣|じん}: the pitching staff
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}{陣|じん}→経営陣：20535_keieijin⟧: the management team

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {陣|じん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to encamp; to take up a position
- ⟦{背水|はいすい}の{陣|じん}→背水の陣：30544_haisuinojin⟧: a last stand with no way back
